parts.text: Your comfort zone is the most expensive place you'll ever liv.
It feels free. Warm bed. Same routine. No risk.
But every month, you pay rent.
With the chances you never took.
The skills you never learned. The people you never met. The version of you that never showed up.
And the rent goes up every year. The longer you stay, the more it costs to leave.
So start paying for growth instead. One uncomfortable thing a day. One hard conversation. One new skill.
Growth is expensive too. But at least you get something back.
